/narrative.1:
The overall objective of PAPFA is to contribute to poverty reduction and stimulate economic growth in the regions of Boucle du Mouhoun, des Cascades et des Hauts- Bassins.
The development objective is to sustainably improve the food security and incomes of farmers working in production and value addition in the rice, market gardening, sesame and cowpea value chains.
